verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows explicit probes for a machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec at all standard locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returning 404, and no claimed-docs items reference a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for the Agentic Commerce Suite APIs. While llms.txt and MCP tooling exist for docs/agent integration, none of these constitute a machine-readable API spec as described in the story.
